run.name: push and start
run.command: git add . || true && git commit -m 'update' || true && git push && npm start

install.name: install
install.command: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json || true && npm install --loglevel=error

push.name: push
push.command: git add . || true && git commit -m 'update' || true && git push

hard push.name: hard push
hard push.command: git add . || true && git commit -m 'update' || true && git push -f

node update.name: node update
node update.command: nvm install 24 || true && nvm alias default 24 || true && nvm use 24
